One lab for the whole insulation system

Our customers range from makers of individual materials to builders of complex machinery, large and small, domestic and international. We work with them to produce the data that supports sound technical decisions.

The facility is seven linked laboratories covering short-term performance, long-term thermal aging, compatibility, EIS thermal life, special projects, fabrication, and calibration verification.

Explore lab capabilities

248 Hughes Lane, St. Charles, MO. 12 minutes from STL Lambert Airport.

What we test

Electrical

Up to 150 kV AC and 100 kV DC. Dissipation factor, dielectric breakdown, insulation resistance, impulse, voltage endurance and surface tracking.

Thermal

More than 100 calibrated ovens to 350 °C and cold chambers to −30 °C, in three oven sizes to suit large and small test objects.

Physical

Tensile, flexural, compressive and impact strength, deformation under load, water absorption and hardness, per ASTM and ISO.

Compatibility

CCT and sealed-tube testing, plus immersion in oils, water, refrigerants, gases and vapor. More CCT has been run here than at all other labs combined.

Flammability

Open-flame (vertical, horizontal, needle) and non-flame (hot wire, glow wire) sources, tested to ASTM, IEC, ISO, NEMA and UL.

Humidity

Five chambers to 100% RH with visible condensation. The largest has an interior 1500 mm wide for large test objects.

Motors, generators, transformers

An electrical insulation system is every material between the copper and the frame. ELTEK evaluates how those materials behave together, for thermal life, compatibility and electrical endurance, so the finished machine lasts.

ISO/IEC 17025 accredited

ELTEK complies with ISO/IEC 17025 as the foundation of its quality management system and laboratory operations. The laboratory is accredited by the International Accreditation Service (IAS) as Testing Laboratory TL-457.

ELTEK is a third-party testing laboratory for internationally recognized certifying bodies, and takes an active part in the technical committees writing new safety and performance requirements.

Lab capabilities

ELTEK can evaluate materials, insulation systems and end products for mechanical, electrical and compatibility properties across a wide range of environments. If you don't see what you need, contact us.

Electrical testing

High-voltage capability from low AC/DC up to 150 kV, plus impulse and endurance testing.

Maximum AC voltage150 kV
Maximum DC voltage100 kV
Impulse, 1.2/50 µsup to 48 kV
  • Dissipation factor / capacitance
  • Dielectric breakdown
  • Insulation resistance (surface / volume)
  • Voltage endurance / corona resistance
  • Surface tracking & CTI
  • Dust-fog / inclined plane tracking
  • Testing in water, oils, refrigerants, gases

Thermal exposures

Short-term and long-term thermal conditioning with 100+ calibrated ovens and cold chambers.

Laboratory ovens100+
Maximum temperature350 °C
Cold exposure−30 °C
Oven interior, smallest380 × 400 × 450 mm
Oven interior, largest740 × 1500 × 1300 mm

All ovens comply with IEC 60216-4-1, IEC 60216-4-2, ASTM D5374 and ASTM D5423. Three oven sizes accommodate a wide range of test object dimensions.

Physical properties

Mechanical testing of materials and assemblies per ASTM and ISO.

  • Tensile, flexural, compressive strength
  • Impact strength
  • Deformation under load
  • Water absorption
  • Hardness

Compatibility testing

CCT / sealed tube evaluations plus immersion in various environments:

  • Water (tap, salt, or contaminated)
  • Oils, liquid and vapor
  • Refrigerants / gases / vapors
  • Water mists (fog)

Flammability testing

Both flame and non-flame heat sources per ASTM, IEC, ISO and UL:

  • Vertical, horizontal, needle flame
  • Hot wire & glow wire ignition
  • Surface flammability, radiant heat

Humidity & condensation

  • 5 chambers, up to 100% RH
  • Visible condensation capability
  • Largest chamber: 1500 mm wide
